messages.content: How many calories are in a tomato?

message.content:
A typical medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **20–25 calories**—usually cited as around **22 kcal**. The exact number varies with size and variety:

| Size (approx.) | Weight (g) | Calories |
|----------------|------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)  | 90         | ~15 kcal |
| Medium (≈123 g)| 123        | ~22 kcal |
| Large (≈182 g) | 182        | ~35 kcal |

Tomatoes are very low in calories because they’re mostly water (≈95 %) and contain only a few grams of carbohydrates, no fat, and negligible protein. They’re also a good source of vitamin C, potassium, and lycopene, an antioxidant linked to heart health.
